name: learning-from-experience
title_zh: 任务中途捕捉程序性意外，沉淀成可复用经验
tagline_zh: 当技能流程不贴场景、新招奏效、失败后翻盘、来源或搭档批评指向旧技能——它替你在现场记下，不等事后遗忘。
tagline_en: When a procedure misfits, a novel move works, a failure recovers, or feedback targets an old skill—it captures.
desc_en: Use mid-task when something procedurally interesting just happened — a skill's procedure didn't fit the situation, a novel approach worked, a failure-then-recovery taught something, a source or your human partner's critique bears on an existing skill, or a procedural surprise resists naming.
why_zh: 它不总结结果，只提炼程序本身：把「当时哪一步该换、为何换」结构化存档，让下次同类意外有据可依。
why_en: It archives the procedure, not the outcome—structuring which step deviated and why, so the next surprise has a reference.
limit_zh: 只在任务中途、且确有程序性意外时触发；不处理任务后复盘，不生成完整案例文档，产出为简短经验条目，需自行归入技能库。
limit_en: Triggers only mid-task with a real procedural surprise; no post-task review, no full case docs—outputs brief entries you must file yourself.
title_en: Capture procedural surprises mid-task, distill them into.
